name: Savage Bite (Combat)
body:
Your bite attack is more fearsome than others of your kind.

Prerequisite: Natural Bite attack

Benefit: The damage caused by your bite attack is increased by one step. For example, 1d3 becomes 1d4, 1d4 becomes 1d6, and 1d6 becomes 1d8.
